findings.title: Customer expresses general preference that vendor stay 'invisible' and issue-free
findings.description: Gregory states his overarching wish is that BetterBark remains invisible to him and that the worst outcome would be being pulled into 'a call about a broken feature.' This is a hypothetical/aspirational remark about the relationship, not a report of any actual current defect, and names no specific feature, behavior, or reproduction detail. Nothing else in the call identifies a concrete product problem.
findings.quote: The moment I'm in a call about a broken feature is the moment I start questioning the whole thing.
findings.severity_reason: No actual defect is described; purely a hypothetical statement about relationship expectations with no product impact to assess.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue applies; there is no specific symptom, scope, or repro to match against any tracked bug or feature.
